title: Target ADHD Executive Working Memory Replication Study
official: Behavioral and Neural Target Engagement for ADHD Executive Working Memory Training
summary: The proposed study will replicate target engagement as assessed in the first phase while also determining if it correlates with clinically meaningful improvements in ADHD dysfunction
criteria:
Inclusion Criteriia:

* Diagnosis of ADHD
* English speaking
* Right-handed
* \>5th grade reading level
* \>80 IQ level

Exclusion Criteria:

* Braces, metal or implant devices
* Brain abnormality, neurological disorder
* TBI or loss of consciousness\>30 minutes
* Diagnosis of Psychosis, Bipolar Disorder, ASD, PTSD, OCD, SUD, Tourette's Disorder
